pull.title: log: move CreateNewBlock() log line behind a new mining category
pull.body:
Fixes #36334

The "CreateNewBlock(): block weight: ..." line was logged unconditionally and could not be turned off, filling the debug log when block templates are built frequently.

Move it behind a new "mining" logging category, enabled with -debug=mining.

events.body:
> Needs a release note that recommends `getblocktemplate` and Mining IPC users enable this category.

Done.

Concept ACK

I did a search of github and google for `"CreateNewBlock(): block weight:` to try and find any other projects which bight be relying on parsing this log line, but didn't find anything noteworthy (except someone trying to [suppress it](https://askubuntu.com/questions/1251985/supress-generatenewblock-output)).

I think adding a new category seems fine and on balance probably appropriate here; I get why it might appear overkill too though (it's only one log line), but I agree it doesn't really fit into mempool, validation, estimatefee or any other current category neatly.

Not strong opinion on the value of the test.

@@ -45,6 +45,7 @@ enum LogFlags : CategoryMask {
     TXPACKAGES = (CategoryMask{1} << 27),
     KERNEL = (CategoryMask{1} << 28),
     PRIVBROADCAST = (CategoryMask{1} << 29),
+    MINING = (CategoryMask{1} << 30),
comments.body:
Adding a whole new log category for a single debug line seems excessive, could we put this behind an existing close-enough category instead? Mempool seems like the natural home: this line is reporting what got pulled from the mempool into the template, and anyone debugging fee/tx-selection issues already runs `-debug=mempool`.
We can add a new category when the examples demonstrate a need.
